classifier.reason: All 57 failures trace to missing implementation, not broken test code. The suite ran to completion (3535 passed, 57 failed) with no import or syntax errors. Most failures are 'unknown kind: roasting', meaning the roasting kind is not registered in the ingest validator yet. Checks for the cropster token property, the cropster department/kind bindings, and the Roasting tab return undefined or are absent, and the end-to-end, upsert, atomicity, shrink-guard and formula-injection sections throw 'Cannot read properties of null' because the Roasting sheet does not exist. Every failure is an assertion or missing-symbol failure the implementation should clear. Caveat: several refusal checks (e.g. 'ok - roasted_kg_out = "5" → refused', 'ok - missing field', 'ok - 501 rows') pass only because the 'unknown kind' refusal fires for any input. Their paired 'message names X' checks correctly fail, so the RED is still valid, but those passing checks are vacuous until the kind exists and should be re-verified once it does.
